apiReferenceObjects.title: Content type snippet element
apiReferenceObjects.markdownContent:
Content type snippet element 

The Content type snippet elements are expanded into the elements that they contain. You can recognize the expanded elements by their codenames, which use the following format: `<content_type_snippet_codename>__<content_element_codename>`.

For example, when you retrieve an item that uses a snippet element with 2 elements, the snippet itself will be structured as the 2 elements, without any encapsulation.

properties.name: transformation
properties.description:
Specifies how to transform the original image asset.

The image area to use for the transformation is determined by the x, y, width, and height properties. The custom_width and custom_height properties set the dimensions of the output image.

The x and y coordinates define a point in the original image. The point is specified as the distance from the top-left corner of the original image asset in pixels. The whole area must be within the borders of the original image. Upscaling, that is setting the custom_width and custom_height greater than width and height, is not allowed.

nestedProperties.name: mode
nestedProperties.description: The transformation's mode. Only the rect mode is allowed.

nestedProperties.name: fit
nestedProperties.description: Controls how the output image is constrained within the provided width and height boundaries after resizing.

nestedProperties.name: custom_width
nestedProperties.description:
The output image's width in pixels. Must be smaller than width.

Use custom_width if you want to resize the rectangle region selected via x, y, width, and height. That is to keep the contents of the selected rectangle region but make the output image smaller.

nestedProperties.name: custom_height
nestedProperties.description:
The output image's height in pixels. Must be smaller than height.

Use custom_height if you want to resize the rectangle region selected via x, y, width, and height. That is to keep the contents of the selected rectangle region but make the output image smaller.

nestedProperties.name: x
nestedProperties.description:
Represents a position on the horizontal axis of the original image as the distance from the image's top-left corner in pixels. Combined with the y property, the coordinates specify the top-left corner of the source rectangle region defined by width and height.

The x's maximum value depends on the width parameter. The whole rectangle must fit within the borders of the original image.

nestedProperties.name: y
nestedProperties.description:
Represents a position on the vertical axis of the original image as the distance from the image's top-left corner in pixels. Combined with the x property, the coordinates specify the top-left corner of the source rectangle region defined by width and height.

The y's maximum value depends on the height parameter. The whole rectangle must fit within the borders of the original image.

nestedProperties.name: width
nestedProperties.description: Starting at the coordinates defined by x and y, specifies the width of the rectangle area.

nestedProperties.name: height
nestedProperties.description: Starting at the coordinates defined by x and y, specifies the height of the rectangle area.

When creating webhooks via API, you need to provide your own secret value. We recommend using a CSPRNG for this. In the UI, the secret is automatically generated for you.

The webhook's custom HTTP headers. This is useful if you need to send extra information, such as authentication details, along with the webhook notification body.

nestedProperties.name: key

  • The key can contain alphanumeric characters (a-z, A-Z, and 0-9) and the special characters - and _.
  • The key cannot be set to the following reserved keys: content-length, content-type, host, request-context, request-id, and traceparent.

apiReferenceObjects.title: Content item delta object
apiReferenceObjects.markdownContent:
Content item delta object 

Metadata specifying a content item in a specific language and the time of the item's last change.

properties.name: change_type
properties.description: Determines whether the content item was modified or deleted since the last synchronization.

properties.name: timestamp
properties.description: ISO-8601 formatted date and time in UTC of the last change to the content item. The timestamp identifies when the change occurred in Delivery API.

properties.name: data
properties.description: The affected content item's metadata.

nestedProperties.name: system
nestedProperties.description: The content item's system properties.

nestedProperties.name: id
nestedProperties.description: The content item's internal ID.

nestedProperties.name: collection
nestedProperties.description: The content item's collection codename. For projects without collections enabled, the value is default.

nestedProperties.name: name
nestedProperties.description: The content item's display name.

nestedProperties.name: codename
nestedProperties.description: The content item's codename. By default, generated from the item's display name.

nestedProperties.name: language
nestedProperties.description:
The codename of the language that the content is in.

For details on retrieving content in different languages, see Getting localized content.

nestedProperties.name: type
nestedProperties.description: The codename of the item's type.

nestedProperties.name: sitemap_locations
nestedProperties.description: A list of sitemap locations that the content item is in.

nestedProperties.name: last_modified
nestedProperties.description: ISO-8601 formatted date and time of the last change to user-content of the content item.

nestedProperties.name: workflow
nestedProperties.description:
The codename of the content item's current workflow. By default, generated from the workflow's display name.

This property is not present for components.

nestedProperties.name: workflow_step
nestedProperties.description:
The codename of the content item's current workflow step. By default, generated from the workflow step's display name.

This property is not present for components.
